thread:
Priya (CS): Hey team — SynthData onboarding blocked: embedding jobs erroring with KMS 'access denied' when trying to decrypt customer key in private deployment. Reported ~10:07 AM PT. Raising for impact and comms.
Lucas (SRE): Saw the alerts. KMS policy on their dedicated key was recently rotated and the control plane's service principal lost decrypt permission. Investigating IAM diff now.
Olivia (AE): They're in middle of a 2-week pilot, 10 seats. Renewal conversation in 4 months. Need a brief customer message and a mitigation plan.
SupportBot: INC-4812 created for SynthData. Severity: P2. Linked infra, cs, ae.
Lucas (SRE): Quick mitigation: can temporarily proxy their embedding requests through the hosted pool using a short-lived customer-scoped key shim. This keeps payloads encrypted under our managed key while we restore KMS policy. Tradeoff: hosted pool will handle ciphertext; no plaintext leaves their environment. ETA to enable proxy: ~25m after approval.
Priya (CS): Draft to customer (please trim): 
> Hi Atlas 141414 
> We're seeing KMS permission failures in your private deployment that are blocking embeddings. We can enable a short-lived hosted-proxy so your jobs can continue while we restore your key policy. No model outputs will be stored outside your project and we'll rotate keys after. Estimated time to restore native path: ~3 hours. Would you like us to enable the proxy or pause jobs until the native path is restored? Apologies for the disruption. - Priya
Olivia (AE): Add an explicit credit offer and an invite to a 1:1 tech sync: "We'll apply a $1,500 credit and schedule a 30-min troubleshooting session."
Jordan (RevOps): I'll mark SynthData as temporarily at-risk and flag for churn-watch. Please capture impact metrics (failed job count, time blackout) so we can quantify credit.
Lucas (SRE): Proxy enabled at 10:35 AM PT for project SD-9001 (routing tag applied). Observability: job success rate jumped from 14% to 98% within 4 minutes. Still validating that keys are never logged and that the shim honors envelope encryption.
Priya (CS): Sent customer note at 10:40 AM PT: "Enabled hosted-proxy to resume embeddings. We'll follow up with RCA and next steps. Please reply if you prefer a pause instead."
Atlas (SynthData): Thanks Priya. We see the backlog clearing. Please proceed with the proxy. Keep us updated on timeline for KMS fix and confirm no plaintext persisted in Redwood logs.
Lucas (SRE): Confirmed: no plaintext written to logs; we double-checked storage audit. Working on policy patch now and will coordinate with the customer's security contact to validate.
Priya (CS): CS action list: (1) apply $1,500 credit once impact window verified, (2) schedule 30-min tech session after RCA, (3) follow up in 24h to confirm onboarding status.
Jordan (RevOps): Noted 14 tagging SD-9001 in renewal risk tracker and adding incident summary to weekly report.
Priya (CS): Can we draft the RCA summary in this thread when available? Lucas, please post the short-form root cause + mitigation items and I'll share with Atlas.
Lucas (SRE): RCA draft in-progress: root cause = KMS policy rotation removed control-plane decrypt grant; contributing factor = lack of pre-flight policy verification during rotation. Mitigations: automatic policy diff check, pre-rotation simulation, and fallback proxy playbook. Will upload draft by EOD.
Priya (CS): Great. Closing internal loop after RCA + credit applied. Leaving follow-up message to customer with technical appendix once Lucas posts RCA.
notes: Private KMS permission failure; hosted-proxy fallback used; credit & tech session offered; renewal risk flagged
